g.title: bundle_runtime_stack
g.text: Model Bundle and FlashRT runtime stack
manifest contract → host prepares bundle / venv / weights → three entry kinds → bundle ships FlashRT

g.title: cluster_1
g.text: A. FlashHub artifacts and weight sources

g.title: repo
g.text: weights record their source; they are never packaged

g.title: env
g.text: select env key by SM / CUDA / Python ABI
exact key first, then match fallback

g.title: ensure_bundle
g.text: FlashHub: marker or index → manifest → SyncBundle
only the selected runtime cell is fetched

g.title: script
g.text: no host routes; manifest env is not applied

g.title: venv
g.text: uv by default; pip is a deprecated fallback
offline reuse when the fingerprint matches

g.title: preflight
g.text: env key must match this host

g.title: native_exec
g.text: serve over stdio is not implemented; run works

g.title: native_abi
g.text: plain run only probes the ABI; sessions run inference

g.title: readiness
g.text: host owns download completeness; the bundle owns allow/require/norm-stats readiness
a present-but-incomplete manifest is never accepted; a ready legacy cache is accepted offline

g.title: py_serve
g.text: standard routes are mounted by flashcli-bundle
register_routes() may override or add routes

g.title: flashrt
g.text: host checks the ABI; it never installs kernels
